snippet.title: Planted! Playtest Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SIGN UP FOR THE PLAYTEST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448000/Planted/
We're absolutely thrilled to announce that we're bringing a PUBLIC PLAYTEST for Planted to Steam!

Read more about it and sign up here - https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3448000/view/663861210724173459?l=english

We'll be offering two distinct modes with two different maps - The Allotment and The Stadium. The playtest will support online and local multiplayer and best of all you'll be able to invite your friends through Steam or via Room Code!

The playtest will also include four different characters and four distinct powerups!

The actual playtest begins May 25th to June 1st, 2026 – so there's only a limited amount of time to sow, grow and throw. So don't delay and get on it!

#Planted #Playtest #multiplayergames
